title: SOCIAL PRIORS: DESCRIPTIONS OF AI USERS SHAPE HOW LANGUAGE MODELS TRUST AND COOPERATE
reasoning: The paper evaluates how finetuning LLMs on 'prosocial' versus 'antisocial' social priors affects their behavior in trust games, their display of dark-triad personality traits (Machiavellianism, psychopathy), and their ethical evaluations (e.g., judging whether AI companies behave ethically), which inherently involves moral reasoning and ethical behavior frameworks.
